headline: Endorsed an ANR plan, approved a site plan modification, and set a February hearing for a special permit on Cabot Street
summary: The board endorsed a Subdivision Approval Not Required plan for 28R and 32 Ober Street, and approved a minor modification to the retaining wall design for the 103 Cabot Street mixed-use project. The board also set a public hearing for a special permit at 371 Cabot Street and approved the December 16, 2025 minutes as amended.
decisions: Endorsed the Subdivision Approval Not Required Plan for 28R and 32 Ober Street, applicant Anthony Graves, 5-0.
Deemed the modification to Site Plan Review #161-23 for 103 Cabot Street as Minor, 5-0.
Granted the modification to Site Plan Review #161-23 for 103 Cabot Street, 5-0.
Set a Public Hearing for Special Permit #204-25 at 371 Cabot Street for February 10, 2026, 5-0.
Approved the December 16, 2025 meeting minutes as amended, 5-0.
